documentation.content: Investigate the rows the verification_reconcile_summary and verification_persistence_attention events count. Then either fix the cause and rerun reconciliation (with --include-acknowledged for acknowledged blocked rows) before Temporal history expires, or acknowledge the row with a reason: python -m scripts.ack_verification_persistence --workflow-id WF --expect-state STATE --by NAME --reason TEXT --apply. An acknowledgement lapses if the row fails differently. See docs/verification-report-retention.md. Never delete or replace an original report to clear an alert.

conditions.displayName: Unacknowledged persistence attention, a failing persist attempt, or a corrupt stored object

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="biosim-gke" AND (jsonPayload.event="verification_persistence_attention" OR textPayload:"verification_persistence_attention" OR textPayload:"verification_persistence_failure" OR textPayload:"verification_object_integrity_conflict")
